documents.title: Certificate under SEBI (Depositories and Participants) Regulations, 2018

analysis.summary: Management stated that Baheti Recycling Industries Limited achieved revenue of approximately 725 crores and profit of 27 crores for FY26. The company is expanding its manufacturing capabilities by commencing 5 new electrical furnaces in FY27, raising total installed capacity to 38,000 tons annually, and setting up an aluminum wire rod project in Dahegam. Management expects sustainable EBITDA margins to remain in the 7% to 10% range. Additionally, the company added major automotive OEMs such as Bajaj Auto, TVS Motor, and Royal Enfield directly to its client roster. Management reported a strong financial performance for FY26, surpassing its stated revenue guidance by 12% and achieving PAT growth of over 15% above guidance.

guidance.claim: The company targets to reach full capacity utilization by FY28.
guidance.quote: Our plan is to ramp up utilization, full capacity utilization by FY28.

guidance.claim: Phase 1 of the aluminum wire rod plant has an annual revenue potential of approximately 250 crores.
guidance.quote: We are targeting in Phase 1 around 12,500 metric ton per annum, with an annual revenue potential of 250-odd crores

guidance.claim: Total revenue from both phases of the aluminum wire rod plant will be around 500 crores.
guidance.quote: That, that means the revenue will also increase by another 250 odd crores. So, total revenue from this plant will be somewhere around 500 odd crores.

guidance.claim: The company enters FY27 with an order book of a minimum of 200 crores, excluding the aluminum wire rod plant.
guidance.quote: We are heading into FY27 with an order of Minimum 200 crores with us. And there are a lot of excitement development. This is excluding order book or the plant of aluminum wire rod.

guidance.claim: The company surpassed its stated revenue guidance by 12% for FY26.
guidance.quote: FY26 has been a good year for us. We closed the year having surpassed our stated revenue guidance by 12%, with PAT growth coming in at over 15% against what we had guided for.

guidance.claim: Management targets revenue of over ₹1,200 Crores by FY28.
guidance.quote: We are confidently positioned to exceed a Revenue milestone of ₹1,200Cr by FY28

guidance.claim: The company expects its Aluminium Wire Rod division Phase 1 to generate between ₹200–250 Crores in annual revenue.
guidance.quote: Phase 1 targets 12,500 MT, which we expect to generate between ₹200–250 Crores in annual revenue.

guidance.claim: Scaling Phase 2 of the Aluminium Wire Rod division to 25,000 MT yields a revenue potential of ₹500 Crores annually.
guidance.quote: When we scale to 25,000 MT in Phase 2 in forthcoming years, the revenue potential from this division alone reaches ₹500 Crores a year.

demand_outlook.claim: Global primary aluminum supply has been disrupted by geopolitical tensions in the Middle East, pushing customers toward reliable secondary sources.
demand_outlook.quote: Global primary aluminum supply has been disrupted, particularly from the geopolitical tension going on in the Middle East, and that is pushing customer everywhere towards reliable secondary sources.

demand_outlook.claim: Demand for aluminum wire rod is high and it is an upbringing industry.
demand_outlook.quote: Aluminum wire rod, if I talk about aluminum wire rod, aluminum wire rod is a good industry. It is an upbringing industry and the demand is huge in aluminum wire.

demand_outlook.claim: Domestic scrap is approximately 7-8% more expensive than imported scrap.
demand_outlook.quote: No, no not that much, to be very honest. We have not compared, but you can say 7-8% would be expensive.

demand_outlook.claim: Confirmed order book stands at over ₹175 Crores as the company steps into Q1 FY27.
demand_outlook.quote: As we step into Q1 FY27, our confirmed order book already stands at over ₹175 Crores, a reflection of the steady demand for secondary aluminium domestically and the trust our clients continue to place in us.

demand_outlook.claim: Disruptions in the Middle East have tightened primary aluminium supply globally.
demand_outlook.quote: Disruptions in the Middle East have tightened primary aluminium supply globally, and the pressure on availability is real.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is ready to commence 5 new electrical furnaces in FY27.
capex_expansion.quote: As part of this, we are now ready to commence 5 new electrical furnaces in FY27.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is investing around 25 crores to build out the aluminum wire rod product in two phases on existing freehold land in Dahegam.
capex_expansion.quote: We are investing somewhere around 25-odd crores to build this out in two phases on our existing freehold land in Dahegam

capex_expansion.claim: Phase 2 of the aluminum wire rod plant will require a maximum of 5 crores for the furnace.
capex_expansion.quote: Phase 2 would be 5 crores maximum in putting up the furnace and all.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is investing ₹20–25 Crores in FY27 to build out the Aluminium Wire Rod division on existing freehold land.
capex_expansion.quote: On the capacity side, we are putting ₹20–25 Crores to work in FY27 to build out our Aluminium Wire Rod division on our existing freehold land.

capex_expansion.claim: Phase 1 of the Aluminium Wire Rod division targets 12,500 MT with expected annual revenue of ₹200–250 Crores.
capex_expansion.quote: Phase 1 targets 12,500 MT, which we expect to generate between ₹200–250 Crores in annual revenue.

capex_expansion.claim: Phase 2 targets scaling to 25,000 MT with a revenue potential of ₹500 Crores a year.
capex_expansion.quote: When we scale to 25,000 MT in Phase 2 in forthcoming years, the revenue potential from this division alone reaches ₹500 Crores a year.

capex_expansion.claim: Total smelting capacity has reached 38,000 MT, with five more electric furnaces lined up for FY27.
capex_expansion.quote: Alongside this, we have been replacing our older pit furnaces with more Electric Furnaces, taking our total smelting capacity to 38,000 MT, and five more furnaces are lined up for FY27.

capex_expansion.claim: Five more electric furnaces are lined up for commissioning in FY27.
capex_expansion.quote: and five more furnaces are lined up for FY27.

capex_expansion.claim: Total smelting capacity has reached 38,000 MT following the replacement of older pit furnaces with electric furnaces.
capex_expansion.quote: taking our total smelting capacity to 38,000 MT, and five more furnaces are lined up for FY27.

capex_expansion.claim: The company incurred a capex of ₹10 crore per pair of Tilting Rotary Furnaces with Skelner.
capex_expansion.quote: CAPEX of ₹10Cr. per furnace per paid incurred to strengthen our manufacturing capabilities.

margins_costs.claim: Revenue for FY26 reached approximately 725 crores and profit reached 27 crores.
margins_costs.quote: During this period, the company delivered, strong growth, with revenue rising to 725 crores almost, and with the profit reaching to 27 crores.

margins_costs.claim: Revenue grew by approximately 38% year-on-year while profit increased by 50% in FY26.
margins_costs.quote: Compared to the previous year revenue of 520 crores and profit of 18 crores, especially our revenue grow by approximately 38% year-on-year, while profit increasing by the 50%.

margins_costs.claim: Cost of production increased by 15% due to fuel prices.
margins_costs.quote: See, the cost of production has increased, no doubt about it, because of the fuel prices, the cost of production has increased by 15%.

margins_costs.quote: Our captive solar plant should be running by end of May 2026 and this directly cuts our power costs on the electric furnaces, and the margin benefit will start showing up from Q2 onwards.
